description: Plan v7 section 8.3 'distinct-but-equivalent loaded tags remaining separate and resolving through exact identity plus tiebreakers'. hy-AM and hy-SU are canonically equivalent (canonicalLanguageTag('hy-SU') is 'hy-AM') but are DISTINCT java.util.Locale values, so the loader keeps two catalogs. Both normalize to language code 'hy', so DefaultStrings requires - and this fixture supplies - the exact permutation tiebreaker list, here ordered hy-AM before hy-SU. Pair.InBoth exists in both equivalent catalogs so the tiebreaker choice is visible in the translation itself; Pair.OnlyInAm and Pair.OnlyInSu prove the catalogs were not merged; Pair.Missing exercises the whole deduped chain. Paired with dedup-and-candidates-equivalent-su-first, which differs ONLY in tiebreaker order.
